correctness.rationale: Differentiating the symmetric quartic excludes exactly lambda=-2,-1,2 for smoothness. Put a²=-lambda-1,b²=lambda+2,s=(1+a)/b; the frozen proof explicitly lists 12 axis, 4 constant, 12 mixed bitangent lines, and checks each by three double-square substitutions. They are generically pairwise distinct and the classical 28-bitangent theorem makes the list exhaustive. The ratios of an axis and mixed line recover s and a, hence b=(1+a)/s, establishing minimality of the common field, not merely sufficiency. Distinct odd valuations of -lambda-1 and lambda+2 give generic V4. Its involutions act via s->-s and s->1/s, yielding 4 fixed, 6 size-2, 3 size-4 orbits. The map lambda=-2(s^4+1)/(s²+1)² has the stated branch fiber and no branch at singular lambda=2. Independent symbolic restrictions and orbit enumeration verified the 28 lines, V4 orbit profile, rational sample lambda=-34/25, and branch derivative. Root-sign analysis gives real bitangent counts 16,28,4. These checks support but are not a substitute for the classical 28-count and all-specializations algebra.
